# Configure shared library
set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

# Subsystems
set(SDL_AUDIO ON CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_VIDEO ON CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_RENDER OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_JOYSTICK ON CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_HAPTIC OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_HIDAPI ON CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_POWER OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL_SENSOR ON CACHE BOOL "")

add_subdirectory(sdl3)

set(SDL2COMPAT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL2COMPAT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "")
set(SDL2COMPAT_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "")

add_subdirectory(sdl2-compat)

add_dependencies(SDL2 SDL3-shared)

# Keep both dylibs together
set_target_properties(SDL3-shared SDL2 PROPERTIES
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/$<CONFIG>")
